author: nade 03
title: Experience
content:
I really like One State RP because you can do so many different roles, create your own stories, and meet people who eventually become your everyday gaming friends. That’s honestly one of the best things about the game.
But lately, the experience has been getting worse because of people using panels, hacks, and other cheats. You can record everything, send proof, open a ticket on Discord, and still wait forever for something to be done. Sometimes they just close the ticket and nothing happens to the person you reported.
What makes it even more frustrating is that sometimes people get banned without even being shown real evidence, while other players seem to get away with everything. At times it honestly feels like some people get special treatment or have connections, and that makes the whole system feel unfair.
A lot of us spend hours playing and some people also spend real money on the game, especially in gang roles, so it’s annoying to lose progress or have your experience ruined because other people cheat. The bugs are another problem top. In my case, I’ve already moved to different servers because of all this, and after a while it gets exhausting. Ireally hope the new update and the anti-cheat system actually fix some of these problems, and I also hope reports and bans are handled more fairly. The game has a lot of potential, and it would be a shame to stop roleplaying and leave because of things that could be handled much better.

author: No watch
title: Remove the hackers on the bell
content:
I am giving OneState a 1-star review because the ongoing hacker and troll problem on the Bell PD server has become extremely frustrating. Many players have repeatedly reported these issues, but it feels like little to no action is being taken to prevent them from returning.

Our wonderful Chief and DFG have had to step away from their roles, and the constant disruption caused by hackers and trolls has been one of the major reasons the community has struggled. Even when accounts are banned, these individuals simply create new accounts and come right back. This cycle continues without an effective long-term solution.

The Bell PD community is exhausted. We spend our time trying to provide a fun and professional roleplay experience, but it is difficult when the same people continue to evade bans and disrupt the server.

I sincerely ask the OneState development and moderation team to implement stronger measures against ban evasion and repeat offenders. Please consider improving account verification, detecting alternate accounts, and enforcing stricter actions against players who repeatedly return after being banned. We care about this community and want to see it succeed, but meaningful action is needed. Please listen to your players and help protect the servers from those who continuously ruin the experience for everyone else.

author: Zach2018!
title: Has Potential
content:
OneState RPG has a lot of potential, and despite my criticisms, I genuinely enjoy playing it. The roleplay can be incredibly fun, and I’ve met some great people. However, there are several issues that I think hold the game back.

One of the biggest problems is the community. I personally don’t care what people think about my sexuality, but I’ve noticed that once some players learn something personal about you, there’s a good chance they’ll start targeting or harassing you. While this won’t happen with everyone, it’s common enough that it hurts the overall experience. From what I understand, same-sex kissing also isn’t allowed in the game. I respect the developers’ right to make that decision, but I think it’s worth mentioning for players who enjoy roleplaying relationships, as it may limit how some people choose to express their characters.

Another concern is the age restriction. The game isn’t intended for children, yet I’ve consistently seen kids playing alongside adults. I know the admins do their best to enforce the rules, but I think the game could benefit from a stronger age verification system or better moderation tools.

The lack of an official reporting system is also frustrating. If someone repeatedly bullies or harasses you, there’s often very little you can do besides avoid them. Since PvP is always active outside of safe zones, it’s easy for the same players to continue making your experience miserable. Safe zones help, but they’re not always enough, especially for newer players who don’t yet understand the mechanics.

I’d also like to see an option to temporarily disable PvP in certain situations. For example, while on a work break, using clocking macros, or simply taking a short break from roleplay. Having a limited cooldown-based PvP toggle could make the game much more enjoyable without ruining the roleplay experience.

The law enforcement system could also use some improvement. In my experience, officers don’t always feel neutral, and sometimes interactions can become disrespectful. Constructive criticism shouldn’t feel like it risks consequences simply for speaking up. Encouraging professionalism would make those interactions much more enjoyable.

Character customization is another mixed area. I really like the customization options, but if you’re in a faction, you’re essentially locked into your work uniform unless you’re on vacation. It would be nice if players could switch into casual clothing while off duty or on break.

Driving physics also need work. Sometimes you’ll barely clip a curb and your vehicle flips multiple times, launch into a tree, or even fall through the map. These bugs can be funny at first, but after they happen repeatedly, they become frustrating.

Overall, I still think OneState RPG is a fun game with a lot of potential. The roleplay itself is enjoyable, and there are plenty of reasons to keep playing. I just hope the developers continue improving moderation, reporting tools, PvP options, driving physics, and quality-of-life features. With those changes, I think the experience would be significantly better for both new and veteran players.
